The vocative clause: «يا داود..» has no grammatical position, a resumption in the course of the story of Dāwūd [Note: or it is in the position of an accusative, the content of an omitted saying, the omitted saying being a ḥāl from the fāʿil of غفرنا, that is: "We forgave him, saying: O Dāwūd"].
The clause «إنّا جعلناك ... » has no grammatical position, the response to the vocative.
The clause «جعلناك ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of inna.
The clause «احكم ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumption, that is: "Be alert, and so judge" [Note: or it is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, that is: "if you undertake to judge, then judge.. with the truth."].
The clause «لا تتّبع ... » is conjoined to the clause احكم and takes its i'rab.
The clause «يضلّك..» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the implied particle-type relative (أن).
The clause «إنّ الذين ... » has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
The clause «يضلّون ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «لهم عذاب ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of inna.

* Morphology:
(24) سؤال: an audited (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb سأل; its wazn is فعال (with ḍamma on the fāʾ and fatḥa on the ʿayn).
(الخلطاء): plural of الخليط, a collective noun (ism jamʿ) meaning the people whose affair is one; it may also be singular, meaning the one who mixes, or shares, or is a neighbour or companion; its wazn is فعيل.. and the wazn of الخلطاء is فعلاء (with ḍamma on the fāʾ and fatḥa on the ʿayn).
There is another plural of الخليط, namely خلط (with two ḍammas).

* Benefits:
- The maṣdar (ما):
It is of two kinds:
a- Purely maṣdar: it is interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar and does not convey the meaning of time, as in His saying, the Exalted, عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ ما عَنِتُّمْ and وَدُّوا ما عَنِتُّمْ, the implied form being (عنتكم), and ضاقَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْأَرْضُ بِما رَحُبَتْ, that is, (برحابتها), and His saying, the Exalted, in the verse we are dealing with لَهُمْ عَذابٌ شَدِيدٌ بِما نَسُوا يَوْمَ الْحِسابِ, the implied form being (بنسيانهم).
b- Temporal maṣdar: it conveys the meaning of a maṣdar and of time, as in His saying, the Exalted, وَأَوْصانِي بِالصَّلاةِ وَالزَّكاةِ ما دُمْتُ حَيًّا whose origin is (مدة دوامي حيا) ("the duration of my remaining alive"); the adverb was dropped and (ما) and its ṣila replaced it, as occurs in the explicit maṣdar, as in (جئتك صلاة العصر) and (آتيك قدوم الحاج), and from this is His saying, the Exalted: (إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا الْإِصْلاحَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ).

safi-cedvel:27-27.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (ما) negative; (الواو) the second and third being conjunctions; (ما) a relative noun in the position of an accusative, conjoined to السماء; (بينهما) an accusative adverb attached to an omitted ṣila of ما; (باطلا) an absolute object (mafʿūl muṭlaq) standing in for the maṣdar, so it is its description, that is, "a false creation" [Note: it may be a ḥāl from the fāʿil, that is, "possessing falsehood".], and the reference in (ذلك) is to the false creation, and it is a mubtadaʾ in the position of a nominative, its khabar being ظنّ; (الفاء) a conjunction; (ويل) a mubtadaʾ, nominative; (للذين) attached to an omitted khabar; (من النار) attached to (ويل).
The clause «خلقنا ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ذلك ظنّ ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كفروا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «ويل للذين كفروا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ذلك ظنّ.
The clause «كفروا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).

safi-cedvel:28-28.t:
* I'rab:
(أم) is the disconnected أم, meaning بل and the hamza, for denial; (كالمفسدين) attached to an omitted second direct object whose operator is نجعل; (في الأرض) attached to المفسدين; (أم) like the first; (كالفجّار) attached to an omitted second direct object whose operator is the second نجعل.
The clause «نجعل الذين ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «عملوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آمنوا.
The clause «نجعل (الثانية) » has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(الفجّار): plural of الفاجر, an active participle from the triliteral فجر (of the pattern نصر), meaning he deviated from the truth, or lied, or rode into acts of disobedience; its wazn is فاعل, and it is pluralised as فاجرين and فجرة (wazn فعلة, with two fatḥas).
